_readme: TERRAIN-SMALL fixture: 64x64 tile map (test-only overlay, NOT the canonical config).
Run with: godot --path variant3d -- --config <absolute path to this file> --screenshot <temp .png>
config.gd reads res://config.json FIRST and merges this file over it (config.gd:229-243).
Therefore ONLY gameplay.map_width_tiles / map_height_tiles change from the shipped 320x320
config: render_mode=3d, random_seed=20261113 and every height/mapgen rule are inherited.
render_mode and random_seed are repeated VERBATIM as an explicit guard, not a change.
